stratagems.name: Anathema Blademastery
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly VIGILATOR SQUAD unit is selected to fight.
TARGET: That VIGILATOR SQUAD unit.
EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, select either [SUSTAINED HITS 1] or [LETHAL HITS]. Melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the selected ability.

stratagems.name: Psy-Chaff Volley
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, just after a friendly PROSECUTOR SQUAD unit has shot.
TARGET: That PROSECUTOR SQUAD unit.
EFFECT: Select one enemy unit hit by one or more of your unit's ranged attacks. Until the end of the turn, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of attacks that target that enemy unit by 1.

stratagems.name: Purgation Sweep
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly WITCHSEEKER SQUAD unit is selected to shoot.
TARGET: That WITCHSEEKER SQUAD unit.
EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of Torrent weapons equipped by models in your unit, or add 2 instead when targeting a PSYKER or Battle-shocked unit.

stratagems.name: Gilded Champion
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Any phase, just after a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES CHARACTER model uses a once-per-battle datasheet ability.
TARGET: That CHARACTER model.
EFFECT: That model can use that ability once more at a legal opportunity in a different phase.

RESTRICTIONS: Once per battle per model.

stratagems.name: Duty Unto Death
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Any phase, just after an ADEPTUS CUSTODES CHARACTER model from your army is destroyed.
TARGET: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES CHARACTER model.
EFFECT: Roll one D6. On a 3+, set that model back up on the battlefield as close as possible to where it was destroyed and not within Engagement Range of any enemy models, with half its Starting Wounds remaining (rounding up).

RESTRICTIONS: You can only use this Stratagem once per battle for each model.

stratagems.name: Assemblage of Might
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an ADEPTUS CUSTODES CHARACTER model from your army is selected to shoot or fight.
TARGET: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES CHARACTER model.
EFFECT: Select one enemy unit. Until the end of the phase, each time that CHARACTER model makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, add 1 to the Wound roll.

stratagems.name: Vigil Unending
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit selects a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES TERMINATOR unit as the target of its attacks.
TARGET: That TERMINATOR unit.
EFFECT: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of attacks allocated to your unit.

stratagems.name: Unleash the Lions
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Command phase.
TARGET: One friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES TERMINATOR unit containing two or more models.
EFFECT: Split your unit into separate units of one model each. Each new unit has a Starting Strength of 1.

stratagems.name: Fury of the Emperor
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Charge phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES TERMINATOR unit that made an Ingress move this turn declares a charge.
TARGET: That TERMINATOR unit.
EFFECT: Add 2 to Charge rolls made for your unit until the end of the phase.

stratagems.name: Honoured Interred
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
TARGET: One friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES DREADNOUGHT unit.
EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit within 6" of your unit makes an attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1.

stratagems.name: Unceasing Onslaught
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, just after a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES DREADNOUGHT unit Advances.
TARGET: That DREADNOUGHT unit.
EFFECT: Until the end of the turn, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have [ASSAULT], and your unit is eligible to declare a charge.

stratagems.name: Unstoppable Momentum
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Movement phase or your Charge phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES DREADNOUGHT unit makes a move or declares a charge.
TARGET: That DREADNOUGHT unit.
EFFECT: Your unit gains the MOBILE ability.

stratagems.name: Shield of Honour
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Start of the Fight phase.
TARGET: One friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES INFANTRY or MOUNTED unit.
EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time an enemy model within Engagement Range of your unit makes a melee attack that targets a different friendly unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll and the Wound roll.

stratagems.name: Superhuman Focus
stratagems.description:
WHEN: End of any phase.
TARGET: One friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit that is not Readied.
EFFECT: Your unit becomes Readied.

RESTRICTIONS: You cannot target the same unit with this Stratagem more than once per battle round.

stratagems.name: In Auramite Clad
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit selects a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit (excluding CUSTODIAN WARDENS) as the target of its attacks.
TARGET: That friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit.
EFFECT: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of those attacks by 1.

stratagems.name: Prime Target
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit is selected to shoot.
TARGET: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit.
EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, you can re-roll one Hit roll, one Wound roll and one Damage roll for ranged attacks made by your unit.

stratagems.name: Unlimited Endurance
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, just after a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit Advances.
TARGET: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit.
EFFECT: Until the end of the turn, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have [ASSAULT], and your unit is eligible to declare a charge.

stratagems.name: Swift as the Eagle
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your opponent's Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly unengaged TRUSTED SENTINEL unit.
TARGET: That TRUSTED SENTINEL unit.
EFFECT: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D3+3".

stratagems.name: Emperor's Domain
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly TRUSTED SENTINEL unit Consolidates.
TARGET: That TRUSTED SENTINEL unit.
EFFECT: Your unit can make an Objective Consolidation even if it does not meet the usual conditions for doing so.

stratagems.name: Avenge the Fallen
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly TRUSTED SENTINEL unit that is Below Starting Strength is selected to fight.
TARGET: That TRUSTED SENTINEL unit.
EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons equipped by non-CHARACTER models in your unit.

stratagems.name: Swift as the Eagle
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your opponent's Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly unengaged TRUSTED SENTINEL unit.
TARGET: That TRUSTED SENTINEL unit.
EFFECT: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D3+3".

stratagems.name: Coordinated Dive
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, just after a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES MOUNTED or VENATARI unit shoots and scores one or more hits against an enemy unit.
TARGET: One friendly unit of the opposite type (MOUNTED or VENATARI) within 12" of that enemy unit.
EFFECT: Until the end of the turn, add 2 to Charge rolls made for your unit if it declares a charge that includes that enemy unit.

stratagems.name: Strike and Disappear
stratagems.description:
WHEN: End of the Fight phase.
TARGET: One friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES MOUNTED or VENATARI unit that fought this phase and is unengaged.
EFFECT: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 8".

stratagems.name: Suppressive Pass
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, just after a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES MOUNTED or VENATARI unit has shot.
TARGET: One enemy unit hit by one or more of that friendly unit's ranged attacks.
EFFECT: Until the end of the turn, that enemy unit cannot make Snap Shooting attacks against friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES MOUNTED or VENATARI units.

stratagems.name: Manoeuvre and Fire
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit Falls Back.
TARGET: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit.
EFFECT: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge.

stratagems.name: Tip of the Talon
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit is selected to shoot.
TARGET: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit.
EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, add 2 to the Strength characteristic of ranged attacks made by your unit that target an enemy within Half Range.

stratagems.name: Rapid Reactions
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your opponent's Movement phase, just after an enemy unit Falls Back from a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES INFANTRY unit.
TARGET: That friendly INFANTRY unit.
EFFECT: Your unit can shoot as if it were your Shooting phase, but must target only that enemy unit.

stratagems.name: Lightning Wrath
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit makes a Pile-in move.
TARGET: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit.
EFFECT: Your unit can Pile In up to 6".

stratagems.name: Golden Light of the Moiraides
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit makes an Ingress move.
TARGET: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit.
EFFECT: Until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from Hit rolls made for attacks that target your unit, and your unit cannot be targeted by Snap Shooting attacks.

stratagems.name: Preternatural Rapidity
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, just after a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit Advances.
TARGET: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit.
EFFECT: Your unit is eligible to declare a charge this turn.

stratagems.name: Bearers of His Light
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit is selected to fight.
TARGET: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit.
EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, melee attacks made by your unit ignore modifiers to Hit rolls and Wound rolls.

stratagems.name: Impenetrable Bastion
stratagems.description:
WHEN: End of your Movement phase.
TARGET: One friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit (excluding MONSTER and VEHICLE units).
EFFECT: Secure one objective marker controlled by your unit.

stratagems.name: Selfless Service
stratagems.description:
WHEN: End of your opponent's Charge phase.
TARGET: One friendly unengaged ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit within 6" of an enemy unit. If it is a VEHICLE, it must be a CHARACTER or WALKER.
EFFECT: Your unit can declare a charge against eligible enemy units within 6".

RESTRICTIONS: The Charge roll cannot exceed 6 after modifiers.

stratagems.name: In Auramite Clad
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit selects a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit as the target of its attacks.
TARGET: That friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit.
EFFECT: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of those attacks by 1.

stratagems.name: Superhuman Focus
stratagems.description:
WHEN: End of any phase.
TARGET: One friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit that is not Readied.
EFFECT: Your unit becomes Readied.

RESTRICTIONS: You cannot target the same unit with this Stratagem more than once per battle round.

stratagems.name: Golden Rush
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Charge phase, just after a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit (excluding MONSTER and VEHICLE units) makes a Charge move.
TARGET: That friendly unit and one enemy unit within its Engagement Range.
EFFECT: Roll 2D6 for each model in your unit, to a maximum of 6D6. For each result of 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.

stratagems.name: Grim Responsibility
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Fight phase, when an enemy unit selects a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES INFANTRY unit as the target of its melee attacks.
TARGET: That friendly INFANTRY unit.
EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed by a melee attack before it has fought, roll one D6. On a 4+, that model can fight before being removed, or on a 2+ if your unit was within range of an objective marker when you used this Stratagem.

stratagems.name: Unbreakable Aurumite
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit selects a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit as the target of its attacks.
TARGET: That friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit.
EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have Feel No Pain 5+.

stratagems.name: Indomitable Guardians
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your opponent's Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has fought.
TARGET: One friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit within range of an objective marker that is eligible to fight and has not fought this phase.
EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, your unit has Fights First and must be the next eligible unit you select to fight.

stratagems.name: Inexorable
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit is selected to move.
TARGET: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit.
EFFECT: Until the end of the turn, ignore modifiers to your unit's Move characteristic, Advance rolls and Charge rolls.

stratagems.name: At Spear's Length
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit Advances or Falls Back.
TARGET: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit.
EFFECT: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge.

stratagems.name: Gravimetric Grenade
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Start of your opponent's Charge phase.
TARGET: One friendly unengaged ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit and one enemy unit visible to it within 12".
EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, subtract 2 from Charge rolls made for that enemy unit.

EFFECT: Your unit becomes Readied.

RESTRICTIONS: You cannot target the same unit with this Stratagem more than once per battle round.

Imperium - Adeptus Custodes.name: Golden Rush
Imperium - Adeptus Custodes.description:
WHEN: Your Charge phase, just after a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit (excluding MONSTER and VEHICLE units) makes a Charge move.
TARGET: That friendly unit and one enemy unit within its Engagement Range.
EFFECT: Roll 2D6 for each model in your unit, to a maximum of 6D6. For each result of 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.

Imperium - Adeptus Custodes.name: Grim Responsibility
Imperium - Adeptus Custodes.description:
WHEN: Fight phase, when an enemy unit selects a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES INFANTRY unit as the target of its melee attacks.
TARGET: That friendly INFANTRY unit.
EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed by a melee attack before it has fought, roll one D6. On a 4+, that model can fight before being removed, or on a 2+ if your unit was within range of an objective marker when you used this Stratagem.

Imperium - Adeptus Custodes.name: Unbreakable Aurumite
Imperium - Adeptus Custodes.description:
WHEN: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit selects a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit as the target of its attacks.
TARGET: That friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit.
EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have Feel No Pain 5+.

Imperium - Adeptus Custodes.name: Indomitable Guardians
Imperium - Adeptus Custodes.description:
WHEN: Your opponent's Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has fought.
TARGET: One friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit within range of an objective marker that is eligible to fight and has not fought this phase.
EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, your unit has Fights First and must be the next eligible unit you select to fight.

Imperium - Adeptus Custodes.name: Inexorable
Imperium - Adeptus Custodes.description:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit is selected to move.
TARGET: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit.
EFFECT: Until the end of the turn, ignore modifiers to your unit's Move characteristic, Advance rolls and Charge rolls.

Imperium - Adeptus Custodes.name: At Spear's Length
Imperium - Adeptus Custodes.description:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit Advances or Falls Back.
TARGET: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit.
EFFECT: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge.

Imperium - Adeptus Custodes.name: Gravimetric Grenade
Imperium - Adeptus Custodes.description:
WHEN: Start of your opponent's Charge phase.
TARGET: One friendly unengaged ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit and one enemy unit visible to it within 12".
EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, subtract 2 from Charge rolls made for that enemy unit.
